findings.desc: doc-code-drift: CLAUDE.md §"Open Questions (OQ) 通道 (B-ed3e)" (line 626) still says the scope-plan reviewer reads the `<requirementsDir>/decisions/` 全目录 (FULL directory) unconditionally. This diff replaces that unconditional full-scan behavior in packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md (and its .claude/.lattice-codex mirrors) with a bounded candidateSpecSet-first routing contract (memory/playbook preflight -> filename enumeration -> candidateSpecSet build, max 15 full-reads -> scanEscalationReason-gated full scan). CLAUDE.md has zero mentions of candidateSpecSet, scanEscalationReason, or the search budget contract anywhere in the file, so it documents the old always-full-scan behavior as still current.

doc-code-drift: packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-behavior.md line 163 claims its candidateSpecSet inputs are consumed through the "same bounded channel as lattice-review-scope-plan", but the two prompts define different candidateSpecSet source lists. scope-plan (line 124): checklist relatedDocs; story title/description/keywords/riskSignals; changed files and symbols; command/config names; `lattice aux_doc_list` output; and top-N rg keyword matches. behavior (line 130): checklist relatedDocs, story title/description/keywords/riskSignals, changed files/symbols, command/config names, and top-N rg keyword matches -- `lattice aux_doc_list` output is omitted. Same discrepancy is mirrored identically in .claude/agents/lattice-review-behavior.md and .lattice-codex/agents/lattice-review-behavior.md (byte-identical to the template). Either behavior silently drops an input source scope-plan uses (breaking the claimed shared-channel guarantee) or the "same bounded channel" wording is inaccurate.
